signal: Tessell raised a $60M Series B to expand its AI-driven multi-cloud DBaaS and launch a conversational database management service

email.body1:
Lee, saw Tessell closed a $60M Series B and is expanding its AI-driven multi-cloud platform into new markets.

Scaling pipeline that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the Mid-Atlantic team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Tessell off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lee, quick follow-up for Tessell.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your Mid-Atlantic region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lee, last bit of proof for Tessell.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Tessell's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B infrastructure startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lee, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B sales motion? I will tailor it to Tessell either way.
